summary: Parallel Parenting Option Builder end-to-end tested: backend (plan GET/PUT, step bounds, filtering, completed_at idempotency, tip 400s, tip success+save, chat multi-turn memory, chat history, PDF 400 empty + 200 success) and frontend (Self Journey banner placement, PP page with safety banner/header/back/home/quick-exit, 6 feature cards, Start/Continue CTA, autosave of answers + notes via reload, resume CTA, AI step tip after Save & Continue, chat empty-state suggestions, multi-turn name recall of 'Zuko', plain-text replies, pp-chat-new, Summary with per-step cards + edit buttons + closing + PDF download). All 13 pytest cases passed. All critical frontend testids resolved; no overlay or input-focus issues observed.
critical_code_review_comments: parallel_parenting_routes.py uses a shared voice/prompt + _plain(limit=600 for tips, 1200 for chat) - consider making the limits named constants.
ChatBody.session_id has max_length=64 but server also accepts any string; consider validating as hex to avoid collisions. Low priority.
PlanBody.step validator uses len(CONTENT['steps']) (currently 6) so 0..6 is accepted; correct and matches the frontend 'summary' step index 6.
test_credentials: parent1@test.com / TestPass123! (safety-flagged); parent2@test.com / TestPass123! (not flagged). Login UI: login-show-email-toggle, login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, then legal-ack-checkbox + legal-ack-continue-button if modal appears.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Test data created during the run was cleaned up at the end: deleted 2 parallel_parenting_plans and 1 parallel_parenting_chats docs for parent1/parent2.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_parallel_parenting.py (needs REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported). PP banner is positioned between door-self-card-foundation and door-self-card-biff (Y 1234/1385/1511 on desktop) as required. Frontend selectors verified in-flight. Fresh plan CTA = 'Start Building My Plan'; with any saved answer CTA switches to 'Continue My Plan · Step N' and pp-view-plan appears. AI tip and chat responses took ~5-10s. Cleanup command used: delete_many on parallel_parenting_plans and parallel_parenting_chats for both test user_ids.
